decision.primary: Implement one fixed-budget shared categorical/axis-aligned local-writer program for the complete first contextual H1 bank, beginning with existing qualified native H0/H1 records. This replaces the proposed unary-table expansion as the next primary question.
decision.initializer: Own raw string -> qualified tokenizer -> complete IDs/mask/positions -> compiled lexical H0. Fixed C supplies only source-qualified rows0–1; no teacher R/H1 in serving.
decision.stateAndFeatures: Preserve the full input packet. Predicates read only causal owned token/history/position/mask registers and explicitly declared lexical coordinates. If predicted state is used in later features, it must be the candidate's own state, never teacher-forced state. Feature extraction itself is paid.
decision.update: For each remaining row p, select signed shared writer atoms with the branch program and perform the frozen finite copy/add sequence: H1_hat[p] = finite_add(H0[p], sum_k sign[k,leaf]*atom[address[k,leaf]]). No dense matrix implementation of the dictionary notation. Produce every active/padding row.
decision.smallestQuestion: Does own-input writer selection produce useful contextual H1 and its next-layer Q/K/V operand response beyond identity/H0 and an equal-budget position-only writer, especially at unchanged-token rows following an earlier edit?
decision.evidencePlan: Use one frozen grammar/budget, whole-history discovery/transfer separation and target-release order, after fresh source qualification. Existing public histories are reused-history transfer, not fresh held-out evidence. Preserve all rows, zero effects, positive and adverse trends. No automatic tree/dictionary/rank/seed sweep, native-image run or new teacher-data campaign.
decision.consumer: Paid original layer1 normalization/QKV is evaluation only, consumed on candidate H1. It must not refresh candidate state or become its serving constructor. A local improvement does not establish later own-state encoder, denoiser or pixel closure.
decision.diagnostic: Define actual finite Delta_hat=H1_hat-H0 and native Delta=H1-H0. A post-seal feasible dictionary selection uses identical slot/sign/dictionary/finite-add capacity. Delta_hat-Delta=(Delta_hat-Delta_Ddiag)+(Delta_Ddiag-Delta); retain signed cross energy. Do not label a heuristic selection globally best or use it for serving.
decision.economy: Charge tokenizer/lexical assets, source labels, fitting/feature preparation, branch/predicate/dictionary bytes, comparisons, causal memory, selected copies/additions, rounding, transfer and consumer work. For L shared BF16 atoms of width2560, raw atom payload alone is5120*L bytes; tree/feature/runtime storage is additional. No economy measured yet.

strongestAlternative.family: Exact unary cofactor at the first variable token after a causally fixed prefix
strongestAlternative.merit: A true source-compositional partial evaluation with a token-indexed finite result and no runtime learned arithmetic for that address.
strongestAlternative.limits: These are literal uncompressed payload estimates, not lower bounds. Offline native formation and finite-profile qualification are additional. It only closes one unary address, cannot be iterated as a contextual rule without a new state argument, and may first target whitespace-dependent tokenizer output. It does not supply Psi for later rows.
strongestAlternative.decision: Keep as a conditional alternative, not automatic full-vocabulary compilation or the primary next construction.

decision.otherAlternatives: Uniform-token symmetry and equal-value classes leave real chat-template/contextual coefficients unresolved; full decision-diagram/bit-GEMM lowering may merely replay original learned arithmetic or explode. Current Taylor forecasts require state-specific dense native compilation. None supersedes the shared-writer experiment on present evidence.
decision.routeChangeCriteria: Useful content-sensitive own-state/consumer transfer with shared atoms supports further program discovery. Position-only equivalence, flat response, history-specific leaves, poor consumer transfer or excessive bytes would narrow this fixed family without proving all symbolic programs impossible. Do not use proof absence as a discovery stop gate.
